# Phzyx — LLM / agent map (0.1)

> Status: **0.1.0** pre-1.0 · **M8** Forge restructure. APIs may change before 1.0. Prefer this file + docs for current APIs.
> **Keep this file updated whenever install / extras / public package surface changes.**

## What Phzyx is

Phzyx is Athul Nandaswaroop’s open-source **ecosystem brand** (TanStack-shaped, polyglot).  
**Forge** (`phzyx-forge`): Pydantic schema, failsafe migrations, ORM, AdminBoard (FastAPI-first; Litestar adapter).  
**Pulse** (`phzyx-pulse`): next product (background tasks) — not in this tree yet.  
**Imports:** always `phzyx.*` (product name ≠ import path).

## Install

- **Product:** `uv add phzyx-forge` — fat wheel: schema + engine + ORM + AdminBoard + CLI + **SQLite**
- **Drivers later:** `[postgres]` · `[mysql]` · `[mssql]` (stack on same package)
- **Batteries:** `[auth]` / `phzyx-auth` · `[cache]` / `phzyx-cache` · `[litestar]`
- **Kitchen sink:** `uv add 'phzyx-forge[full]'` = every driver + auth + cache + Litestar
- **Public PyPI names only:** `phzyx-forge`, `phzyx-auth`, `phzyx-cache`
- CLI: included with forge; `phzyx new myapp` / `phzyx forge init`
- Dev monorepo: `uv sync --all-packages` (split packages for development)

## Scaffold (preferred app shape)

```bash
phzyx new myapp --preset max
# app/api async · app/forge dual session + registry · mount_forge(app)
phzyx db push --models app.forge.registry:ALL_MODELS --yes
uvicorn app.main:app --reload
```

Existing project: `phzyx forge init --yes` (island only; does not clobber main.py).

## Canonical docs (public site)

1. https://phzyx.xyz/forge/getting-started — **primary human path**  
2. `/forge/cli` · `/forge/security` · `/forge/guides/*`  
3. `/forge/adminboard` · `/forge/apiboard` — AdminBoard + **API Board** (Forge API Client at `/apiboard/`)  
4. `/forge/compare` — honest positioning  
5. `/performance` — API throughput results · `/stats` — package traction  
6. `/forge/reference/packages` — import + extras map  

7. Monorepo `CODING_STANDARDS.md` · `ROADMAP.md` · this `llms.txt`  
8. Public site agent maps: https://phzyx.xyz/llms.txt · https://phzyx.xyz/llms-full.txt  

## API Board (Forge API Client)

- **URL:** `/apiboard/` (FastAPI `AdminBoard(mount_apiboard=True)` default)
- Interactive try-it for the **current server** OpenAPI (not a Postman clone; not nested Admin chrome)
- Document format: `phzyx.forge.client` v1 JSON — environments, collections, history, savedResponses
- Modes: **sandbox** (`sessionStorage`) · **workspace** (`localStorage`, scoped by OpenAPI title@version)
- Platform-bound env: `baseUrl` (and `sessionUser` when signed in) read-only on “This server”
- Code: `packages/admin/web/src/features/apidocs/forgeClient/`

## Package map

### Public PyPI

| PyPI | Import / role |
|------|----------------|
| phzyx-forge | full product (fat wheel) + SQLite core |
| phzyx-auth | phzyx.auth |
| phzyx-cache | phzyx.cache |

### Monorepo modules (dev; ship inside phzyx-forge on PyPI)

| Folder | Import |
|--------|--------|
| packages/schema | phzyx.schema |
| packages/engine | phzyx.engine |
| packages/orm | phzyx.orm |
| packages/admin | phzyx.admin |
| packages/admin-fastapi | phzyx.admin.fastapi |
| packages/admin-litestar | phzyx.admin.litestar |
| packages/cli | CLI `phzyx` |
| packages/auth | phzyx.auth |
| packages/cache | phzyx.cache |
| packages/meta-forge | workspace meta for phzyx-forge |

## Hard product rules (public)

- uv workspace; imports `phzyx.*`; public PyPI: forge + auth + cache
- Bare `phzyx-forge` = full product + SQLite; `[full]` = all drivers + batteries + Litestar
- No `phzyx/__init__.py` at namespace root (PEP 420)
- AdminBoard UI: Vite + TS + React + TanStack Query/Table/Router + Zustand (UI only)
- Themes: Magical White + Stellar Dark primary; System Ambient secondary
- Files: keys in DB; multi-cloud storage; not blobs in Postgres
- Product voice: positive; no dunking on peers
- Phzyx website: sites/web → phzyx.xyz (docs at /forge)
- Never commit secrets
- **Update llms.txt / sites/web/public/llms*.txt on every install or extras change**
